examples.text: Há pegadas de gato na mesa.
examples.en: There are footprints of a cat on the table.

examples.text: Havia pegadas de pinguins na areia.
examples.en: There were penguin footprints in the sand.

examples.text: Tom parece ter pegado um resfriado.
examples.en: Tom seems to have caught a cold.

examples.text: Havia pegadas enlameadas no chão da cozinha.
examples.en: There were muddy footprints on the kitchen floor.

examples.text: Ele deve ter pegado o trem errado.
examples.en: He must have taken the wrong train.
